subject: How can I cluster samples using only Differentially methylated region?

messages.author: 36488b271701c318
messages.subject: How can I cluster samples using only Differentially methylated region?
parts:
Dear All, 

I wonder how can I cluster samples using only Differentially Methylated Region. 
I means, I want to filter my methylBaseDB using DMR analysis result and I want to see clustering result from that. 

How can I do that?

Regards,
-Youngjune-

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: How can I cluster samples using only Differentially methylated region?
parts:
Dear Youngjune,

If I understood correct you want to filter an methylBaseDB object based on an methylDiff object. The following snippet could achieve this:

```
data("methylKit")

## get the DMRs 
hyper.dmr <- getMethylDiff(.Object = methylDiff.obj,type = "hyper")
hyper.dmr

## filter methylBaseDB based on DMRs
hyper.mbase <- selectByOverlap(methylBaseDB.obj,ranges = as(hyper.dmr,"GRanges"))
hyper.mbase

## cluster
PCASamples(hyper.mbase)

```

Please note: 
"hyper.mbase" will be an in-memory methylBase object and to save as DB again use makeMethylDB().  
Besides, this will work independently of using methylDB or normal methylKit objects. 


Best, 
Alex
